subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: For Android chat bubbles, should the approved scope be Copy/Select Copy only, or the full Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply long-press action sheet proposed here?
rationale: Current main still lacks the behavior, but implementation attempts show that Reply semantics and gesture/link interaction need product and owner-scope choices before another automated fix should be queued.

options.title: Approve full action sheet
options.body: Land a refreshed Android implementation with Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply, including clear Reply semantics and proof that links and scrolling still work.

options.title: Narrow to copy/selection
options.body: Limit the next implementation to Copy and Select Copy, leaving Share and Reply for separate issues after the core copy path is proven.

options.title: Adopt or close the fork PR first
options.body: Review the conflicting fork PR as source material before deciding whether OpenClaw should replace it with a fresh target-repo PR.

recommendation.title: Approve full action sheet
recommendation.body: Land a refreshed Android implementation with Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply, including clear Reply semantics and proof that links and scrolling still work.

likelyOwner.reason: Ayaan Zaidi has the strongest repeated Android chat implementation history across markdown rendering and chat screen behavior.
